inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if comparable sales and unit economics weaken structurally, franchisees retrench, leverage rises, or distributions exceed durable free cash flow.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: Asset-light franchise fees and unit growth can transmit recurring demand into shareholder cash returns if franchisee economics and comparable sales remain healthy.

objective: Review whether Domino's Pizza has a material causal relationship to defensive consumer cash-return resilience.
